saw_lines: Oral care buyers find the one interdental size that fits their gap, then reorder it on a schedule and rarely switch.
So the sale is won in line one. A buyer who does not see their gap named in the opener keeps scrolling.

points: None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the brand. Add one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

Your 30 ads open with 18 different stories, and the biggest leads only 4. Keep the brushed but not feeling fresh opener and the brush missed a spot opener, and write three new variations of each for the next batch.
26 of 30 ads push Learn more and only 4 push Shop now, so the 15% offer lands on a campaign page. Switch the offer ads to Shop now, linked to a CPS product page, and keep Learn more for stories.

Your 30 ads spread across Facebook, Instagram, Threads and Audience Network, but the copy never names a feed. Keep the next batch on Facebook and Instagram, and give Threads and Audience Network their own short-form cut to test separately.
